append.detail: Turned on in eslint.config.mjs as an error, with type information, for the money, notification, webhook, Space automation, CRM and join paths (lib/billing, lib/notifications, lib/spaces, lib/crm, app/api, app/join). Typed linting of the whole app takes about six minutes, so the scope grows path by path as each is cleaned. Ten bare calls in scope were fixed; six query wrappers that would have hung forever on a rejected query now resolve to an empty list. The 335 silent .catch(() => null) sites are a different pattern and are not part of this rule.
